dessin: A cropped excerpt of a printed topographic map seen from above, filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge: the pale paper color #FBFCF8 covers the whole image, no outer background color, no frame, no border, no outline around the image, no margin; the drawing is cut cleanly by the four image edges as if the map continued beyond them. A raster image only: the whole excerpt is a coarse mosaic of equal square pixels in a regular grid (about 24 columns by 16 rows), each square flat filled with either light green #9DAF8A or dark green #5F7550, forming two or three irregular dark areas on a light ground like a pixelated aerial photograph. No grid lines between the squares, no other color, no other shape. No text, no letters, no numbers, no contour labels, no symbols other than those described, nothing else.
